matchups.matchup:
D.Va's Defense Matrix can easily swallow your slow-moving Xuanwu Staff orbs, and her extreme vertical mobility allows her to contest you on the high ground after you use Rushing Torrent. Because your Guardian Wave requires a walkable surface to cast, if she bumps you into the air with her Boosters, you will be temporarily locked out of your primary defensive cooldown.

If she uses Self-Destruct, you lack the mitigation to protect your team. However, casting Tidal Blast on yourself or an ally will grant 400 overhealth, allowing you to easily survive the explosion if you cannot break line of sight.
matchups.synergy:
D.Va is an excellent dive partner. Because Restorative Stream's passive healing remains attached to an ally even if they break line of sight for up to 5 seconds, you can attach it to D.Va right before she boosts into the enemy backline. 

While you cannot place Tidal Blast on her exploding mech, placing it on her while she is actively diving gives her 400 overhealth and a massive speed boost, turning her into an unkillable disruption engine. When the knockdown triggers, she can easily secure eliminations with her Micro Missiles.

matchups.matchup:
Wuyang is one of the best supports in the game for bypassing Domina's fortifications. Because you can manually steer charged Xuanwu Staff orbs, you can easily guide them completely over or around her massive 27-segment Barrier Array, hitting her directly without needing to break her shields.

If she traps your team in her Panopticon cage ultimate, you cannot heal them from the outside. However, if you are caught inside the cage with her, immediately cast Tidal Blast on yourself or an ally. The ultimate's explosion pierces barriers, guaranteeing a knockdown on Domina within the enclosed space.
matchups.synergy:
Domina heavily mitigates incoming damage with her shields, which perfectly covers Wuyang's biggest weakness: his slow-regenerating healing resource meter. Because Domina rarely takes heavy chip damage, you can passively heal her while dedicating your resources to your DPS.

Furthermore, Domina loves to control long sightlines. Wuyang can stand safely behind her Barrier Array, charging and steering his water orbs into the enemy backline with zero risk of being pressured by enemy Sharpshooters.

matchups.matchup:
Doomfist is a massive threat to Wuyang. Wuyang has no hard crowd control to stop a dive, and his only escape tool, Rushing Torrent, can be easily chased down by a competent Doomfist using Seismic Slam. Worse still, if Doomfist lands a Rocket Punch on you, the stun will instantly cancel your active channel of Restorative Stream, cutting off your burst healing.

Your best defense is positioning. Use Rushing Torrent to take high ground where Doomfist must expend cooldowns just to reach you. If he does dive you, immediately cast Guardian Wave to knock him back slightly and buy yourself time to reposition. If you are caught in the open, your only hope of survival is to use Tidal Blast on yourself, as the knockdown explosion will cancel Doomfist's Power Block and force him to retreat.
matchups.synergy:
Wuyang pairs excellently with Doomfist. Because Restorative Stream's passive healing remains attached to an ally even if they break line of sight for up to 5 seconds, you can attach it to Doomfist right before he dives deep into the enemy backline. He will continue to receive a steady drip of healing while completely out of your view.

Furthermore, Doomfist is an incredible target for Tidal Blast. If he dives into a clustered enemy team, casting Tidal Blast on him will grant him massive overhealth to survive the focus fire, and the ensuing knockdown explosion will set up a guaranteed, multi-kill Meteor Strike or Empowered Rocket Punch.

matchups.matchup:
Hazard's geometric disruption can severely limit Wuyang's flow. His Jagged Wall can physically block the path of your Guardian Wave, preventing your shockwave from reaching allies or knocking back enemies. Furthermore, you must avoid blindly firing your uncharged orbs into his Spike Guard, as the homing retaliation spikes will quickly whittle down your health.

If Hazard uses Downpour, immediately activate Rushing Torrent to quickly escape the massive 40% slow effect applied by his destructible crystals before they detonate.
matchups.synergy: Hazard's volatile, high-mobility playstyle synergizes brilliantly with Tidal Blast. Casting your ultimate on Hazard right before he activates Downpour is a devastating combo: he will hover in the air raining spikes while protected by 400 overhealth, and when he lands, the ultimate will explode, knocking down any enemies trapped in his rooting crystals.

matchups.matchup:
Junker Queen is heavily restricted to the ground, meaning you can easily evade her with Rushing Torrent and safely poke her from high ground. You can also continually push her away with Guardian Wave when she attempts to engage with her axe.

However, her Rampage ultimate is a death sentence for Wuyang. The anti-heal completely shuts down your Restorative Stream, Guardian Wave, and the massive 250 burst heal of your Tidal Blast. If you hear her ultimate voice line, prioritize dodging it at all costs.
matchups.synergy:
Junker Queen absolutely thrives with Wuyang. Her massive weakness is her lack of gap-closing speed, which your Tidal Blast completely solves. Granting her a 50% speed boost and 400 overhealth allows her to charge headfirst into the enemy team, and the knockdown explosion guarantees she can land a massive Carnage swing on multiple targets.

Additionally, casting Guardian Wave on her provides a +50% healing amplification that mathematically supercharges her Adrenaline Rush lifesteal passive, making her practically unkillable in a brawl.

matchups.matchup:
Mauga will absolutely melt Wuyang if you are caught out of cover. His continuous incendiary fire will rapidly deplete your 225 HP, and his Overrun charge makes him completely unstoppable, meaning your Guardian Wave knockback will not stop his engage.

If he traps you in Cage Fight, Rushing Torrent cannot escape the chains. You must immediately cast Tidal Blast on yourself; the knockdown explosion will force him to stop firing and potentially break his offensive momentum inside the cylinder.
matchups.synergy:
Wuyang struggles to keep Mauga alive during prolonged engagements. Mauga takes immense amounts of focused damage, which will completely drain your Restorative Stream resource meter in seconds, leaving your frontline vulnerable.

You must rely heavily on timing. Wait until Mauga activates Cardiac Overdrive, then cast Guardian Wave on him. The 50% healing amplification will massively increase his self-lifesteal, allowing him to sustain himself while your resource meter recharges.

matchups.matchup:
Orisa is too slow to effectively chase Wuyang, allowing you to use Rushing Torrent to comfortably kite her. You can easily steer your charged Xuanwu Staff orbs around her Javelin Spin.

Be aware that her Fortify completely negates both the knockback of your Guardian Wave and the knockdown effect of your Tidal Blast explosion. Do not waste your offensive utility on her while she is glowing gold.
matchups.synergy:
Because Orisa is a Stalwart tank with incredible self-mitigation (Fortify, Javelin Spin), she does not require intense burst healing. This allows Wuyang to easily conserve his Restorative Stream resource meter. 

Tidal Blast provides Orisa with the one thing she lacks: movement speed. Casting your ultimate on her allows her to aggressively run down fleeing enemies, and the knockdown explosion practically guarantees she can secure a kill with her Energy Javelin.

matchups.matchup:
Ramattra's Nemesis Form Pummel pierces completely through cover and barriers, making him highly dangerous to duel at mid-range. His Ravenous Vortex is a hard counter to your Rushing Torrent, as it will violently yank you out of the air and strip away your mobility advantage.

If he pops Annihilation, you can shut him down by casting Tidal Blast on an ally inside his swarm. The explosion will knock him down, completely interrupting his Block stance and burning precious seconds off his ultimate timer.
matchups.synergy: Ramattra becomes a terrifying vanguard when paired with Wuyang. Casting Tidal Blast on him right as he enters Nemesis Form gives him the speed to close the gap on fleeing targets, and the 400 overhealth protects him while he drops his barrier. When the knockdown triggers, he can easily Pummel the grounded enemies to death.

matchups.matchup:
Reinhardt's massive Barrier Field is virtually useless against Wuyang's Xuanwu Staff. Because your charged orbs ignore gravity and can be steered, you can simply guide them over the top of his shield and drop them directly onto his head for full splash damage.

His Earthshatter is a major threat to your Tidal Blast; if he shatters you during your 3.5-second ultimate windup, you will be stunned and potentially eliminated before the explosion triggers.
matchups.synergy: Wuyang and Reinhardt are a match made in heaven. Reinhardt's primary issue is closing the gap without taking lethal damage. Casting Tidal Blast on Reinhardt turns him into a glowing, 50% faster juggernaut with massive overhealth. When he reaches the enemy line, your ultimate explodes, knocking everyone down—acting as a mini-Earthshatter that allows Reinhardt to cleave the entire enemy team with his hammer.

matchups.matchup:
If Roadhog lands his Chain Hook on you, you are instantly dead. Wuyang has a relatively predictable movement trajectory while channeling his Restorative Stream or steering his orbs, making him prime hook bait. Play tightly around cover and use Rushing Torrent unpredictably to avoid being displaced.

If Roadhog uses Whole Hog, the extreme knockback will keep you pinned against geometry. Your only counterplay is to cast Tidal Blast to survive the initial burst and hope the knockdown interrupts his momentum.
matchups.synergy:
Roadhog acts as a massive sponge for damage, which will deplete your healing resources very quickly. However, combining Guardian Wave with his Take a Breather results in an absurd amount of damage reduction and healing amplification, allowing him to survive almost any ultimate combination.

Tidal Blast on a flanking Roadhog is devastating, as the speed boost allows him to literally run past enemy tanks to hook the backline directly.

matchups.matchup:
Sigma excels at poking, but so do you. You can easily steer your water orbs around his Experimental Barrier, though you must be careful not to feed his Kinetic Grasp, which will convert your 100-damage charged orbs directly into his overhealth.

His Gravitic Flux is highly dangerous because Wuyang cannot cast Guardian Wave while suspended in the air. If you are caught, cast Tidal Blast immediately to guarantee you have overhealth when he slams you into the ground.
matchups.synergy:
Sigma's high self-sustain and poke-heavy playstyle perfectly matches Wuyang's rhythm. You rarely need to burn your resource meter to keep Sigma alive. 

This duo truly shines during ultimate combinations. When Sigma casts Gravitic Flux, you can cast Tidal Blast on him or an aggressive DPS. As the enemy team is violently slammed back into the ground by Sigma, your Tidal Blast explosion will trigger simultaneously, instantly knocking them down again and dealing massive burst damage to guarantee the team wipe.

matchups.matchup:
Winston's Barrier Projector is a nightmare for Wuyang, as it physically blocks the line of sight required to maintain Restorative Stream and intercepts your Guardian Wave. Furthermore, his Tesla Cannon completely bypasses your high evasion during Rushing Torrent.

Because of Winston's Electric Charge perk, he gains up to 30% movement speed while damaging you, making it incredibly difficult to escape him even with your movement abilities. You must save Guardian Wave specifically to knock him backward when he lands his Jump Pack.
matchups.synergy:
Winston is an incredible dive partner for Wuyang. You can attach Restorative Stream to him right as he uses Jump Pack, ensuring he receives continuous healing inside his bubble while you safely build your resource meter from afar.

Casting Tidal Blast on Winston right before he initiates Primal Rage is practically unfair. The 50% speed boost combined with his leap makes him impossible to escape, and the knockdown explosion leaves the enemy team helpless as he juggles them into corners.

matchups.matchup:
Wrecking Ball's extreme speed makes him an impossible target for your slow-moving water orbs. If he lands a Piledriver on you, the vertical displacement will temporarily lock you out of casting Guardian Wave until you land.

If he deploys Minefield (especially if augmented by the Multi-Ball perk), your Rushing Torrent becomes extremely dangerous to use, as the lack of ground friction makes it easy to accidentally slide directly into explosives.
matchups.synergy:
Wrecking Ball operates entirely independently, meaning you can focus 100% of your Restorative Stream resources on your DPS. Because you can attach your passive stream to him, he will constantly heal while rolling around the map looking for health packs.

Casting Tidal Blast on him while he grapples into the enemy team ensures that even if he misses his initial bowling strike, the subsequent 7.5-meter knockdown explosion will massively disrupt the enemy formation.

matchups.matchup:
Wuyang must be very careful not to accidentally steer a fully charged, 100-damage Xuanwu Staff orb into Zarya's Particle Barrier, as it will instantly grant her massive amounts of weapon energy. 

If she catches you in a Graviton Surge, your only defensive option is to cast Tidal Blast on the clustered group to absorb the incoming burst damage with the 400 overhealth. Be aware that Zarya's bubbles completely block the knockdown effect of your ultimate.
matchups.synergy:
Zarya and Wuyang can form an aggressive frontline. If Wuyang is dived, Zarya can project a bubble onto him, giving him the crucial seconds needed to use Rushing Torrent to escape.

If Zarya is at high energy, casting Tidal Blast on her removes her only weakness: her lack of mobility. With a 50% speed boost and massive overhealth, a fully charged Zarya will simply walk forward and vaporize the enemy backline before the ultimate even explodes.

matchups.matchup: Wuyang's sister is a dangerous foe. Between her naturally high movement speed and dual charges of Inferno Rush, she'll have no real issue closing the distance with you, removing your ability to charge your orbs and greatly reducing your damage, or chasing you during Rushing Torrent. She can dodge your Guardian Wave with her Dancing Blaze, denying you burst damage that can turn the fight in your favor. Do your best to track her position so she can't take you by surprise, ward her off before she can close the distance with orbs, and don't let her bait your Guardian Wave.
matchups.synergy:
You and Anran have similar movement potential, so you can easily keep pace with her. With you at her side, she can be more aggressive thanks to your healing and the damage from your orbs will help her finish off targets quickly. Even when you're playing from a safer position, your Water Ring can help keep her topped up so she doesn't have to retreat for a health pack. 

 Your ultimates pair well. Her Vermillion Ascent enables her to effortlessly close the gap with the enemy team, maximizing the number of targets hit by your ultimate. It does considerable damage on its own, which will put most  enemies into lethal range for your Tidal Blast. If used after she's already engaged with her ult, the overhealth will keep her alive even in the thick of the enemy team. If she revives with Vermillion Revival while surrounded by enemies, your ultimate can enable her to continue the aggression or get her out safely.

matchups.matchup: Ashe can be a considerable threat if she catches you out in the open - especially during Rushing Torrent - but she is also an easy target to hit with your orbs as she has only one movement skill and her positioning is rather predictable. Her Dynamite is a problem, as you have no way to cleanse the burn from your team. If she throws it at you, use the burst of movement from Rushing Torrent to get out of the blast radius. B.O.B. is easy to hit, but since you can't headshot, it will take quite a few orbs to take him out. Unless your team is focusing him, you're better off trying to pick off Ashe herself.
matchups.synergy:
There isn't a lot of direct synergy, though she fills a role that you are sorely lacking in: anti-air. Both of you are weak to divers and flankers, so stay nearby so you can support each other. You can finish off targets she has dropped to low health with The Viper and Dynamite, even once they've broken her line-of-sight by taking cover.



 There isn't much use spending your ultimate on B.O.B., since he doesn't move once he's taken a position and he can leave before it detonates. The overhealth can buy him some more time, but its typically better to just heal him and save your ult for another use.

matchups.matchup:
With resource-limited healing and no way to protect your team from damage, Bastion poses a deadly threat with its Configuration: Assault mode. The burst of healing from Guardian Wave can buy an ally time to get to cover. Tidal Blast can also work to save an ally, but beware that its damage output in Assault mode will tear through the overhealth quickly. 

 While comparatively weak when its not in assault mode, Bastion still deals considerable damage in Configuration: Recon mode, so keep near cover, be careful jumping (especially during Rushing Torrent) and take advantage of your orbs to pressure it from safe positions.
matchups.synergy:
Bastion is a hero that draws a lot of attention from the enemy team and thanks to its large hitbox and low mobility, it tends to take considerable damage as a result. You lack any means of shielding or protecting it and the constant drain on your healing resource will leave you unable to help other members of your team. An area where you do synergize is with your Xuanwu Staff: not only in finishing off enemies that Bastion brings to low health, but in taking advantage of the fact that enemies will flee to natural cover or behind barriers to protect themselves when it enters Configuration: Assault mode. 

 There is almost no synergy to be had with your ults. The knockdown from your Tidal Blast can make it easy for it to land Configuration: Artillery, but this is almost always overkill. Sometimes the enemy will try to kill Bastion while it is using its ult, so your Tidal Blast can prevent it from dying and leave the enemy in a bad position.

matchups.matchup: As a hitscan, Cassidy can take advantage of the forced arc of movement when you jump during Rushing Torrent, so be mindful while he's in your line of sight. Flashbang is a death sentence if he manages to catch you with it, so keep your distance and take advantage of his inability to reach highground. With a generous hitbox, no mobility or self-sustain, he is a good target to constantly pressure with your Xuanwu Staff. You have no way to protect your team from Deadeye - Tidal Blast can interrupt his ult if it hits him, though with a 3.5 second wind up this is not easy to pull off.
matchups.synergy: While a Cassidy on your team benefits you, as he excels against heroes you are particularly weak against such as fliers and flankers, there isn't much you can offer him. The overhealth from Tidal Blast can protect him while he's using Deadeye, but the biggest threat to his ult is interrupts which Tidal Blast cannot prevent.

matchups.matchup: While her hitbox is fairly large, her ability to to take Flight can make it difficult to land shots with your staff. You have no way to cleanse Sticky Bombs, so try to keep Guardian Wave ready to heal yourself or an ally out of Focusing Beam threat range. Your Tidal Blast can be an effective counter to her Duplicate and is especially useful when she copies your tank.
matchups.synergy:
Though a flier, Echo's playstyle is more in line with flanker/dive, enabling much stronger synergy between you. For the most part you can keep up with her using Rushing Torrent and, with your assistance, she can play much more aggressively. Your Xuanwu Staff and her Sticky Bombs are a great pair, as well as her Focusing Beam. 

 Whether your ultimate combos well with hers depends entirely on who she Duplicates. She is a strong contender even when she isn't duplicating, however, as she has enough mobility to ensure that enemies are within range and her Focusing Beam can finish off any targets that are still alive after the detonation.

matchups.matchup: As a hitscan, Emre can take advantage of the forced arc of movement when you jump during Rushing Torrent, so be mindful while he's in your line of sight. His Cyber Frag and ultimate, Override Protocol, both present problems: you don't have any way to prevent burst damage. Tidal Blast can save a single ally from his ult, but he'll rarely use his ult against a single foe and, since he's flying during his ultimate, its unlikely he'll even be hit with the detonation. He relies entirely on Siphon Blaster for self-healing and mobility, making him a good target to constantly pressure with your Xuanwu Staff.
matchups.synergy: Since Emre is a hitscan, having him on your team is a benefit to you as he can tackle fliers - a huge problem for you - but you don't have much to offer him. He isn't typically a good target for your Tidal Blast, though it can help him during his ult thanks to the overhealth and movement speed boost.

matchups.matchup: Freja is perhaps Wuyang's most difficult match-up in the game, and certainly the most difficult damage role match-up. With two charges of Quick Dash and Updraft which makes her airborne, she is a very hard target to pin down. Take Aim is a low-cooldown, high burst damage ability that refreshes whenever she uses her dash ability, allowing her to deal huge amounts of damage to your team which you are completely unable to prevent. Bola Shot is a death sentence if she hits you directly with it, so keep Rushing Torrent handy so you can dodge out of the way. Your ult can protect a single ally caught in her Bola Shot, however this should only be done if you're certain your team can win the fight. She generates her ult very quickly - don't let her bait you into spending yours when it may be needed elsewhere. Similarly, don't let her bait your attention. Unless there's nobody else on screen, attack somebody else.
matchups.synergy: Your Restorative Stream passive healing is about as much synergy as you two get. While highly mobile, Freja is unlikely to be close enough to make use of Tidal Blast's detonation and she doesn't need the movement speed bonus.

matchups.matchup:
Ana's Biotic Grenade is a brutal hard counter to Wuyang, as the anti-heal effect completely negates Restorative Stream, Guardian Wave, and the massive burst heal of Tidal Blast. Furthermore, her Sleep Dart will instantly interrupt your active Restorative Stream channel. However, Ana's complete lack of mobility makes her incredibly susceptible to your Xuanwu Staff—you can safely stay behind cover and manually steer charged orbs directly into her.

If Ana catches you with an anti-nade, use Rushing Torrent immediately to break line of sight and wait out the duration, as you possess no self-cleanse mechanics.
matchups.synergy:
Ana and Wuyang form a devastating support composition. Ana provides the hard crowd control and offensive utility (Anti-Heal and Sleep) that Wuyang completely lacks. Staggering your Guardian Wave with her Biotic Grenade creates massive, virtually unkillable team-wide healing surges.

Because Ana has no mobility, she requires your protection. If she is dived by flankers, use Guardian Wave to forcefully peel the enemies off her, and attach your passive Restorative Stream to her so she doesn't have to waste her Biotic Grenade to heal herself.


Give Nano Boost and Tidal Blast to a single target is one of the most terrifying combo. Especially with Dragonblade.

matchups.matchup:
Baptiste's Immortality Field can completely negate the lethal threat of your Tidal Blast explosion. However, you have the perfect tool to counter this: a well-timed Guardian Wave will forcefully knock Baptiste and his allies completely out of the Immortality Field's radius, leaving them vulnerable.

Be careful when trying to poke him with your orbs; his Exo Boots allow him to jump high into the air, making it difficult to track him with your slow-moving projectiles.
matchups.synergy: Stacking Wuyang's Guardian Wave healing amplification with Baptiste's Regenerative Burst and AoE secondary fire makes your team functionally immortal during heavy brawl engagements. You can also safely poke the enemy team by steering your Xuanwu orbs through his Amplification Matrix without exposing yourself to incoming fire.

matchups.matchup:
Wuyang's kit naturally keeps Brigitte at bay. You can easily stay out of her melee range using Rushing Torrent, and if she attempts to close the distance with Shield Bash, you can completely stuff her engagement by knocking her backward with Guardian Wave.

Your primary fire splash damage is somewhat effective at chipping around her barrier, and a well-placed Tidal Blast explosion will bypass her shield entirely.
matchups.synergy: Brigitte and Wuyang thrive in close-quarters brawl compositions. Guardian Wave's 50% healing amplification massively buffs Brigitte's Inspire passive, allowing her to generate terrifying amounts of AoE sustain. Placing Tidal Blast on Brigitte right as she initiates Rally turns her into an unstoppable vanguard, as the massive 400 overhealth and movement speed boost will allow her to run down the entire enemy team before the knockdown explosion triggers.

matchups.matchup:
Illari's hitscan Solar Rifle damage is highly threatening to Wuyang while he is airborne during Rushing Torrent. However, Wuyang excels at destroying her Healing Pylon from complete safety by curving charged Xuanwu Staff orbs around corners and chokepoints.

If Illari catches you in a Captive Sun detonation, immediately use Rushing Torrent to retreat. While your Tidal Blast grants overhealth to survive the initial burst, the slow effect from Captive Sun will make it very difficult to position your knockdown explosion effectively.
matchups.synergy: Illari's Healing Pylon handles the team's passive chip damage, allowing Wuyang to conserve his precious Restorative Stream energy for critical moments. Because Illari excels at locking down a core position, Wuyang is free to use Rushing Torrent to flank or take high ground, dropping passive healing streams onto diving DPS teammates.

matchups.matchup:
Jetpack Cat can be incredibly frustrating for Wuyang to deal with. Because she is in permanent flight, trying to hit her with the slow-moving, arcing projectiles of your Xuanwu Staff is incredibly difficult, even if you try to manually guide them toward her. Furthermore, her flight completely trivializes the ground-based knockback of your Guardian Wave.

If Fika catches you isolated, she can dive bomb you with Catnapper, knocking you down, interrupting your Restorative Stream channel, and tethering you so you cannot escape with Rushing Torrent. Your best bet is to play near cover to force her to engage you in enclosed spaces where your explosive orbs are easier to land.
matchups.synergy:
Wuyang and Jetpack Cat struggle to find common ground. Jetpack Cat spends almost the entire match in the skybox, meaning she will almost never benefit from your ground-based Guardian Wave healing amplification. Furthermore, while you can attach Restorative Stream to her, she frequently breaks line of sight by flying over rooftops, meaning your passive stream will constantly time out.

This composition also lacks a reliable defensive ultimate to counter massive incoming burst damage, as Catnapper is single-target crowd control and Tidal Blast is single-target burst protection.

matchups.matchup:
Juno's extreme aerial mobility makes it incredibly difficult to land your Xuanwu Staff orbs on her. Her sustained lock-on damage can pressure you, but she lacks the burst required to quickly execute you.

You can utilize Guardian Wave to forcefully knock grounded enemies completely out of the healing and damage radius of her Orbital Ray ultimate, denying her team the advantage.
matchups.synergy: Juno's Hyper Ring combined with Wuyang's Rushing Torrent gives Wuyang an absurd amount of traversal speed, making him nearly impossible to pin down. Her AoE Pulsar Torpedoes benefit greatly from your Guardian Wave amplification, and her mobility allows both of you to aggressively support dive tanks simultaneously.

matchups.matchup:
Kiriko's Protection Suzu is a brutal counter to Tidal Blast. If she times her Suzu right as the 3.5-second fuse expires, the brief invulnerability will completely cleanse your knockdown effect and negate the explosion damage. You must force out her Suzu before committing your ultimate.

Her Swift Step allows her to easily dodge your slow-moving orbs, and her high critical hit multiplier makes dueling her extremely dangerous, as Wuyang has a relatively predictable head hitbox while steering his projectiles.
matchups.synergy:
Kiriko provides the essential cleanse utility (Protection Suzu) that Wuyang lacks, protecting his team from lethal anti-heal effects. 

When Kiriko casts Kitsune Rush, Wuyang transforms into a terrifying artillery piece. The massively increased fire rate and reload speed allow you to flood the enemy backline with fully charged, manually steered Xuanwu orbs, forcing them out of position while outputting tremendous splash damage.

matchups.matchup:
Lifeweaver is a relatively easy target for your poke damage, as his large hitbox and predictable movement make steering your orbs into him very simple. You can easily hit him while he is standing on his Petal Platform.

Be aware that he can use Life Grip to pull an enemy to safety right before your Tidal Blast detonates on them. His Tree of Life can also be used to block line of sight from your ultimate's explosion.
matchups.synergy: Lifeweaver provides the vertical utility and allied saving mechanics that Wuyang lacks. If Wuyang overextends with Rushing Torrent, Lifeweaver can easily pull him back to safety. However, this support duo heavily lacks offensive utility (no damage boost, anti-heal, or debuffs), requiring your DPS and Tank to secure eliminations through sheer attrition and sustain.

matchups.matchup:
Lúcio is generally far too fast and erratic to hit consistently with your projectiles. Furthermore, if he is Wallriding high above the ground, you won't be able to hit him with the ground-based shockwave of Guardian Wave.

His Sound Barrier is a strong counter to Tidal Blast, as the massive overhealth will completely absorb your explosion damage, though the knockdown effect will still apply to grounded targets.
matchups.synergy: Lúcio's speed boost helps Wuyang reposition and land aggressive Guardian Waves. However, this composition has very low single-target burst healing unless Wuyang aggressively burns through his Restorative Stream resource meter. This pairing requires a highly coordinated, fast-moving team that ends fights quickly before your resources are depleted.

matchups.matchup:
Mercy's Guardian Angel makes her highly evasive and difficult to track with your slow projectiles. If you catch her alone without an ally to fly to, she is incredibly vulnerable to your charged orbs.

If you time it perfectly, the 1.5-second knockdown from Tidal Blast can interrupt her Resurrect channel. However, because Tidal Blast has a 3.5-second windup, you must pre-plan the ultimate and place it on an ally directly on top of the downed enemy's soul before she commits to the resurrection.
matchups.synergy: Mercy can heavily damage boost Wuyang's charged orbs, allowing him to secure lethal poke damage from complete safety. Because Wuyang can handle the bulk of the team's healing requirements with Restorative Stream, Mercy is freed up to hard-pocket the DPS characters.

matchups.matchup:
This duel highly favors Mizuki if you allow him to get close. Mizuki's Binding Chain is a lethal threat to you—if he lands it while you are using Rushing Torrent, it will instantly halt your momentum, pull you to the ground, and leave you helpless. Furthermore, his Kekkai Sanctuary completely absorbs your Xuanwu Staff orbs from the outside, meaning you cannot poke him out of his ultimate.

To win this matchup, you must play at range. Use your manually-guided, charged orbs to poke him from behind cover. If he uses Katashiro Return to dive you, immediately cast Guardian Wave to knock him back, then use Rushing Torrent to create distance before his invulnerability frames trigger. If you keep him at arm's length, his Spirit Glaive will struggle to out-damage your passive self-sustain.
matchups.synergy:
Wuyang and Mizuki form a highly aggressive, brawling support line. Your Guardian Wave amplifies all incoming healing, which perfectly stacks with Mizuki's Remedy Aura and Healing Kasa bounces, allowing your team to sustain through immense amounts of punishment during close-quarters team fights.

The major weakness of this composition is a lack of verticality. While you can reach high ground with Rushing Torrent, Mizuki is entirely ground-bound (lacking even a wall-climb passive). If your team is playing a highly mobile dive composition that constantly takes high ground, both of you will struggle to keep up and provide consistent healing.

matchups.matchup:
Moira can easily use Fade to completely dodge the explosion of Tidal Blast or escape your controlled orbs. Avoid fighting her in enclosed spaces where her Biotic Orb will aggressively drain your health, as your only reliable self-sustain tool is your 14-second cooldown Guardian Wave.

If Moira casts Coalescence, you can use Tidal Blast's knockdown explosion to instantly cancel it, but predicting her positioning 3.5 seconds in advance is difficult.
matchups.synergy:
Combining Wuyang's Guardian Wave amplification with Moira's Biotic Orb and lingering primary fire results in an absurd, nearly unrivaled amount of AoE healing.

However, this composition is entirely one-dimensional. You possess zero utility (no cleanse, no anti-heal, no damage boost, no discord), making your team highly vulnerable to utility-heavy supports like Ana or Kiriko. Both Wuyang and Moira also rely on resource meters to heal, meaning if a fight drags on for too long, your frontline will completely collapse.

matchups.matchup:
A Wuyang mirror is a pure test of positioning, cover usage, and resource management. Both players will try to poke each other around corners with controlled orbs, so recognizing the enemy Wuyang's orbital arcs is essential to dodging his damage.

Ultimate tracking is critical here. If the enemy Wuyang places Tidal Blast on an initiating tank, you can immediately place your own Tidal Blast on that exact same tank. Your ultimate's 400 overhealth will allow your tank to survive the enemy explosion, and moments later, your explosion will trigger, knocking down the enemy frontline in retaliation.
matchups.synergy: In game modes with no role limits, a double Wuyang composition is highly disruptive. You can stagger your Guardian Wave cooldowns to provide the team with a permanent 50% healing amplification and constant AoE knockback. You can also place two overlapping passive Restorative Streams onto a single flanking DPS (like Genji or Tracer), granting them a permanent, passive 40 HP/s recovery while they harass the enemy backline completely out of your line of sight.

matchups.matchup:
Zenyatta's Orb of Discord is highly lethal to Wuyang, as you have no defensive cooldowns or barriers to block incoming amplified damage. However, Zen's complete lack of mobility and wide hitbox make him the perfect target for your charged, controlled orbs.

If Zenyatta pops Transcendence to save his team, your Tidal Blast damage will be out-healed, but the 1.5-second knockdown effect will still hit any grounded enemies within the radius, completely locking them in place while the invulnerable Zenyatta watches helplessly.
matchups.synergy: Zenyatta provides the exact offensive pressure and utility that Wuyang lacks through his Orb of Discord. Because Zenyatta is highly vulnerable to dive tanks and flankers, Wuyang can actively protect him by knocking away divers with Guardian Wave and leaving a passive Restorative Stream attached to him so he doesn't easily die to chip damage.

matchups.matchup: D.Va's Defense Matrix does nothing to stop your primary attack, making her an easy target. Barrier will either force D.Va to stop firing or provide you a large Energy surge, all while still letting you continue attacking. Your only concern against D.Va is her high mobility with Boosters; if you whittle her down to low health, either try to lob a few secondary fire shots at her, have a teammate chase her down and finish her off, or fall back and regroup with your team. Once out of her Mech, while D.Va is of little threat at close range, she can be extremely difficult to deal with at a distance. Her Light Gun has very little damage falloff and is extremely accurate, meaning if you aren't behind cover or protected by your Barrier she can land successive headshots on you while you have few means of attacking back. Hide behind corners and either try to flank her or have a more mobile ally deal with her. Protecting yourself and an ally with Barrier will negate D.Va's Self-Destruct, providing you a massive amount of Energy in return. Keep in mind that D.Va's Defense Matrix can negate your Graviton Surge, so try not to fire it when she's in front of you.
matchups.synergy: A team clustered together with Graviton Surge is a prime target for a friendly D.Va's Self-Destruct, provided your enemies aren't being protected by a Barrier.

matchups.matchup:
You are able to counter Doomfist reletively well if you are paying attention to him. His abilities don't do enough damage to kill you instantly and you can negate most of it with your barriers. Be careful though, you can still be knocked back by his Rocket Punch and other abilities even while your barrier is active.



If he uses his ultimate, stand right where he is going to land and use your barrier. This will cause all the damage to go to your barrier and will protect everyone in the area.
matchups.synergy: Enemies trapped in a Graviton Surge are ideal targets for Meteor Strike. Once all targets are lined up in the center ring, he can inflict 300 HP of damage, killing all squishy targets.

matchups.matchup: Fusion Driver is a projectile weapon that can inflict headshots, and has no range limit. In short, Orisa outclasses you in ranged duels and can fight far from the effective range of Particle Cannon. Be careful before using a Graviton Surge on Orisa, who can use Fortify to escape and body block incoming damage for allies clustered behind her. To circumvent this, use Graviton Surge when Fortify is on cooldown.
matchups.synergy: The damage-boosting effects of Supercharger can help Zarya shred through enemies at high charge.

matchups.matchup:
Void Accelerator has no damage falloff and no range limit, allowing him to poke your beyond your effective range. That given, do be afraid to use your barrier to soak up damage and build energy. In close range duel, you'll benefit from absorbing his punches while he's in Nemesis form.


Also, if you have both charges, you can use them both when he uses Annihilation. This will not only protect you from damage, but also end his ultimately quickly (Annihilation ends after 3 seconds without damaging someone). Though, this may only work if you alone are in his ultimate's AOE.
matchups.synergy: Enemies trapped in a Graviton Surge will be unable to escape Annihilation before he can deal serious damage to them

matchups.matchup: Reinhardt's Barrier Field can block most of your attacks. Should he try to attack you or a teammate with Fire Strike or Charge, be ready to absorb it with your Barrier. You'll survive a Charge even if you don't have a Barrier active, but you'll be left with minimal health, meaning you'll be quickly picked off if you don't quickly deploy a Barrier or get healed by an ally. When you're at high Energy, you can pressure his Barrier Field and try to shatter it. A quick Barrier will protect you and a teammate from Earthshatter, which can prove life-saving for a fight. Interestingly, anyone who stands behind a teammates with an active Barrier will likewise not be stunned by Earthshatter; with this in mind, if you anticipate an Earthshatter coming, you can position yourself in front of your teammates to shield them.
matchups.synergy: With Projected Barrier, Zarya can allow Reinhardt to lower his shield and go on the offensive. That way, he stays safe while he's attacking enemies and provides Zarya with Energy. When your bubbles expire, you can hide behind his shield. Since both of their ults immobilize targets, it makes it easier for them to attack enemies, especially highly mobile ones.

matchups.matchup: A well-time Barrier will disrupt Roadhog's Chain Hook, whether you use it to save yourself or shield an ally snatched by his Hook. The Chain Hook is dangerous while your Barriers are on cooldown, so try to stay behind cover until you're ready to use them again. At low Energy you'll find it difficult to out-damage Roadhog, especially when he's using Take a Breather to restore health. At high Energy, though, you should be able to kill him while Take a Breather isn't active due to his large frame and lack of self-protection. Keep in mind that your health is lower than most Tank heroes, and that Roadhog's Scrap Gun will tear through most of your health if you aren't careful.
matchups.synergy: Roadhog has a large hitbox and is often a damage sponge, use this to your advantage by having him take damage while your barrier is on him. Though, if paired with a Roadhog your team lacks protection and proper shielding.

matchups.matchup: Hyperspheres have a bit more range than Particle Cannon. Even if you lob your explosives, he can use his shield to block them or use Kinetic Grapes to absorb them and gain shields. However, your beam cannot be negated by Kinetic Grasp so if his shield goes down, he's low on defenses. He'll have to use Accretion to stun you, but if your Particle Barrier is off cooldown, you can block his attack, and gain Energy. That can be said when facing his Hyperspheres or Gravitic Flux.
matchups.synergy: Sigma can move forward with a Projected Barrier to absorb damage, giving you Energy. His Experimental Barrier and Kinetic Grasp is also a great asset to your defenses. Enemies caught in a Graviton Surge can be weakened further with Gravitic Flux and become easy pickings. However, your composition has very low mobility.

matchups.matchup: Without Graviton Surge, you might find some difficulty facing him and his mobility. Damage falloff for Quad Cannons begins at 15 meters, the distance where your beam cuts off. Watch your position because if Wrecking Ball sees that you're near an environmental hazard (i.e. Ilios Well), he will most certainly come charging to you and your bubbles don't stop knockbacks. That being said, you can still use your bubbles to soak up some of his damage, especially from Minefield. If you and one other teammate are in a Minefield, use both your personal and projected bubbles to gain up to 80 energy.
matchups.synergy: Wrecking Ball fights at close-quarters, and that where Zarya's Projected Barrier can thrive. You can put a bubble on him as he rolls into the enemy team and gains energy for you. Their ultimate abilities can complement each other. Enemies trapped in Graviton Surge are ideal targets for Minefield. This is more compounded when done in tight corridors, where the mines also latch to the ceilings and walls.

matchups.matchup: Winston's constant mobility makes him capable of eaching you or your teammates with ease. His auto-multitargeting Tesla Cannon can harm both you and your teammates when you are clustered together. His Barrier Projector will protect himself from any harm he may take from your Particle Cannon, and it will be difficult to shatter when you are at low Energy. However, the situation will improve should you gain more Energy, as you can easily outdamage him after he's landed with Jump Pack if you're near his landing area. While your Particle Barrier won't absorb much energy from Winston’s Tesla Cannon, it will leave him few means of retaliating while you open fire on him. Winston’s Jump Pack can’t be used to escape from your Graviton Surge, which is especially useful when he activates Primal Rage. Try to stay close to your team, and you will be able to handle Winston fine.
matchups.synergy: Winston needs to be close to his enemies in order to be useful, so make sure to keep an eye on him when he leaps in and give him a barrier. Just make sure he has not used his Barrier Projector yet or it has been destroyed.

matchups.matchup: It's difficult to gain Energy from an enemy Zarya, as each of you can simply stop firing once the other puts up a Particle Barrier. Instead, focus on gaining Energy from your other enemies, then use that power to attack the enemy Zarya.
matchups.synergy:
You won't often find another Zarya on your team outside of custom games or No Limits. But when you do, make sure you spread your barriers out evenly in order to maximise your charge aquirement. 

|}

matchups.matchup: Ashe will most likely be sniping you from a distance and away from your Particle Cannon's effective range. If she throws Dynamite at you, you can use your barriers to gain energy from it, especially from its burn overtime.
matchups.synergy: Ashe is usually in the backlines of a match so you won't often meet up. But Ashe's Dynamite and Bob can be devastating if throw into a Graviton Surge.

matchups.matchup: In Sentry configuration, Bastion can tear through your barriers instantly and kill your before you can get up to full charge. If you catch Bastion by surprise at full-charge, you are more than capable of killing him, but this is extremely difficult if Bastion is set up in a good spot. Graviton Surge merely pulls Bastion into the vortex; it doesn't take him out of Sentry Configuration, which can cause more harm than good for your team.
matchups.synergy:
A friendly Bastion in Sentry configuration can be a perfect target for Projected Barrier, especially in a "pirate ship" team composition on a payload map. You can also stand in front of Bastion with your personal barrier in order to soak up damage for him, be careful though, you block his line of sight in the process.




In Sentry and Tank forms, Bastion can easily wipe out enemies caught in a Graviton Surge. This is because Bastion's Configuration: Tank does a precise 205 damage, this will pierce Zenyatta's Transendence.

matchups.matchup: Cassidy can attack you from far out of your effective range thanks to his Peacekeeper's high damage at medium-range. His signature Flashbang combo won't be as effective against you as weaker heroes, but it will still tear through considerable health. Your Barriers are a good block to Cassidy's high-damage single attacks, protecting you from damage while providing high amounts of Energy. Quickly deploying Barriers on you and an ally can also help counter Deadeye. If Cassidy is harassing you at long range, let your teammates deal with him while you hang back and focus on using Barrier to protect your team.
matchups.synergy:
Cassidy is very vulnrable to being dove, although he has his Flashbang to help him, it won't always be enough, so make sure to cover his back, and in return he'll cover yours.
His Deadeye can be a good combo ultimate with yours. Just make sure to put a barrier on him as he is slow and vulnrable in this state. Also make sure there are now barriers blocking his line of sight.

matchups.matchup:
Echo is very difficult to deal with, her flight allows her to stay out of your effective range and her beam can easily melt you with your low health pool and large hitbox. But you can get some decent charge from her primary fire and sticky bombs. So if you see a teammate with sticky bombs on them, give them a barrier ASAP to negate the sticky bomb's damage as well as her follow-up damage.



Be careful if she replicates you, she will try and get a Graviton Surge which could be very destructive once she obtains it.
matchups.synergy:
Echo is quite squishy and an obvious target while airborne, so she might get focused, Throw a barrier on her if that is the case. 
Make sure to protect her while she is using her Duplication, this is so that she can build her Duplication's ultimate quick enough without dying.

matchups.matchup: Genji's can't deflect your Particle Cannon's primary fire, but he can deflect your secondary fire, so try not to use it around him (or wait until Deflect is on cooldown). With enough Energy, you can tear Genji down in seconds if you aim precisely, but if a Genji is aware of this, he can keep himself in your face and attack you with Shuriken or Fan of Blades. Your Barriers can both protect yourself and your allies from Genji, but his low damage output won't result in high Energy charges. Don't chase him if he performs Swift Strike to flee; you are too slow to keep up with him. Keep in mind that your Graviton Surge can be Deflected, which can prove disastrous for your team. Be careful when using it around Genji, especially if you haven't seen or heard him use Deflect recently.
matchups.synergy:
Genji usually jumps into the enemy team, this can be an oppurtunity for you to bubble him and get ome good charge, all while protecting him in the process. This is especially important during his Dragonblade, where he becomes a key target.



Just be careful not to bubble him while he is using Deflect, because it will block off his Deflect and will prevent him from getting any value from it.

matchups.matchup: Hanzo can't shoot you down with one headshot, but he can still badly wound you with one shot. Hanzo excels in attacking at mid- to long-range, and when combined with his ability to climb walls and air dodge, he can maneuver to safe positions out of your range. Your Barriers can be used to help you and your team approach Hanzo without getting shot down. Your secondary fire can hit Hanzo with some adjustment on minor arcing. If you can spot him, try to time your Barrier right when he attacks to save yourself and gain some charge. A grounded Hanzo is less of a threat; if there are no walls to climb, you can approach him without fear and run him down.
matchups.synergy: While many Ultimates work well with Graviton Surge, Hanzo's Dragonstrike is one of the best matches. If you can pin a group of enemies together, even if they have barriers up, they won't be able to protect themselves from a Dragonstrike running through them. Your only concern will be a Zenyatta or Lúcio using their Ultimates, so be wary of them.

matchups.matchup: Junkrat's grenades can provide a decent amount of charge, although he will normally stay out of your primary fire's range. If he's watching a choke, though, you can put up Barriers to protect yourself and an ally while building up charge. If Junkrat dies near you, quickly apply a Barrier to absorb his grenades and gain charge in the process.
matchups.synergy:
Protect Junkrat if he is being dove as well as when he is using his RIP-Tire.



His RIP-Tire is also a very good ultimate to combo with Graviton Surge, this is because it is an instant amount of high damage.

matchups.matchup: Mei can prove to be frustrating in many ways; Cryo-Freeze will force you to either walk away or waste energy waiting for Mei to thaw out, and Ice Wall will stop you dead in your tracks, as you have no mobility options outside of walking around it. Mei can outdamage you at medium to long-range thanks to her accurate Icicles. While Mei can be frustrating in both close and long-range, she lacks enough killing power to put you down for good, as you are capable of taking two Icicle headshot without dying. Barrier can remove Mei's freezing effect, helping you or a teammate stay unfrozen and kill her. You can burn Mei down within seconds when you have enough Energy, but she'll still be able to use Cryo-Freeze to heal herself and Ice Wall to disengage. With a well-placed Ice Wall, Mei may be able to protect her team if they are grabbed by your Graviton Surge, so be cautious.
matchups.synergy:
Mei can often be a detriment if she is on your team, blocking off the line of sight with her walls as well as waisting your barrier with her Cryo-Freeze.



However, her Blizzard is a very good combo with your ultimate, make sure you two are on terms with eachother.

matchups.matchup: With Jump Jet, Pharah can maintain airborne attitude long enough to freely attack you without threat of your Particle Cannon reaching her. It will be difficult for you to contest Pharah in an open area; she will eventually descend when she runs out of fuel, but it will only be a moment before Jump Jet shoots her back into the air. She can also use Concussion Blast to keep you out of your ideal range. Your Barrier can absorb stray shots towards you or an ally, but it's not ample enough to block against Pharah's Barrage. Keep away from Pharah whenever possible, unless you lure her into a corridor where you can fight her at close range where you're more comfortable.
matchups.synergy: Pharah's Barrage and Zarya's Graviton surge make the two together a beast. The Barrage coming from Pharah with an active Graviton Surge can mean a huge amount of damage for the team, but with an active Sound Barrier or Transcendence from an enemy it could keep them on top of health. Use at your own risk, or reap the rewards.

matchups.matchup: While you and Reaper both prefer to fight at close distances, Reaper's Hellfire Shotguns can chew through your health pretty quickly. Barrier can momentarily protect you, but he can simply cease firing to avoid giving you Energy. Should you activate it mid-fight, though, this will provide him less reaction time. If Reaper is heckling your teammates, be ready to protect them with a Projected Barrier. Be wary that his Wraith Form can allow him to escape Graviton Surge.
matchups.synergy:
Reaper has to be close to his enemies to be effecient, so make sure to put a barrier on him when you can. Especially during his Death Blossom, this will prevent him from being focused down or stunned out of it.


Speaking of which, his ultimate his a good one to pair with yours, make sure to tell him when to spin into it.

matchups.matchup: Sojourn's Railgun has incredible range and combined with her Power Slide, she can attack from all sides. However, the high damage of her weapon can play to your advantage. With your Particle Cannon, you can block her high-damaging attack and gain a lot of energy. More popularly, you can use your barrier against her Disruptor Shot and gain energy.
matchups.synergy: Disruptor Shot pairs great with Graviton Surge as it applies extra damage to ensnared target. It may even kill them. Also, they're neatly lined up for Sojourn to target with her Railgun.

matchups.matchup: Even when hacked, you can hold your own against Sombra due to the low damage of her Machine Pistol. Barrier will put a stop to Sombra's Hack, so if you notice one in progress on yourself or an ally, a quick Barrier deployment can cut her off. Sombra's superior mobility and escape tools can make her difficult to kill off, so stick with your team and be alert. EMP will not only nullify your abilities, but will eliminate any active Barriers while also depleting your 200 Shields to drop your health down to 200. Losing your active barriers(s) can be used to your advantage, though, as their destruction will provide you a massive Energy burst to your Particle Cannon. Don't get overly confident, though, as this while you'll be able to fend off attackers, your lowered health combined with your low mobility will make you easy prey.
matchups.synergy:
Sombra is usually off in the enemy's backline or flanking, so you won't usually see eye-to-eye that often. Also, make sure not to put a barrier on her while in stealth, for it can reveal her presence.


Her EMP is one of the best ultimates in the game and can make a great combo. Using her EMP in your Graviton Surge can prevent anybody inside from fighting back and rendering them useless.

matchups.matchup: The splash damage from Particle Cannon's secondary fire is useful for indirectly attacking Symmetra's Sentry Turrets. Conversely, you can charge into an area with Turrets set up and use Particle Barrier to soak up damage and convert it to Energy while destroying the Turrets. Likewise, if any of your teammates are caught by a Sentry Turret, be ready to give them a quick Projected Barrier to protect them and negate the slowdown effect. Only engage Zarya if you're at high Energy or if your Barrier is ready; while you'll win against her if protected by your Barrier, if you try to fight a prolonged battle with her, her Photon Projector's damage ramp-up will eventually run through you.
matchups.synergy: Symmetra is in the same boat as you when it comes to offensive capabilities. So stick close to her. Her teleporter can also get you to the frontlines faster.

matchups.matchup: Tracer can dodge your beam with ease, even while it is on high charge, and her Recall lets her escape from a poor attempt at killing you. A few shots and a Pulse Bomb can instantly kill you when stuck to you, so be ready to use your Barrier if she approaches you.
matchups.synergy: Many ultimate abilities work well with the Graviron Surge, but Tracer's Pulse Bomb ultimate ability can cause mayhem, with multi-kills, if stuck onto an opponent in the Gravitron Surge. This could also mean a team kill, if a whole team is in the surge. As per usual, be wary of support-based ultimates.

matchups.matchup: While Widowmaker can't kill you with one headshot, her extreme range makes her hard for you to handle. Her suppressing fire, along with her Grappling Hook that can help her relocate, can shut off an entire area for you to safely move through. Your secondary fire can hit a high-elevation Widowmaker with some arcing adjustment, but these attacks will rarely be enough to finish her off. Try to get another ally to approach and take down Widowmaker, and consider giving them a Barrier to protect them from her. While you are lacking in mobility, if you catch Widowmaker on the ground, you can tear through her in seconds regardless of your Energy level.
matchups.synergy:
You and Widowmaker will often be on the opposite sides of the battlefiend, however, she is very fragile and prone to being dove. So if you see her in trouble, give her a barrier so she can get out or secure the kill if necessary.
|}

matchups.matchup: Ana's low damage won't provide very much Energy charge, and at lower Energy it will be difficult for you to kill opponents that are being healed by Ana. Ana's extreme attack range will allow her to stay outside of your effective range. However, Ana needs 5 shots to kill you at full health. You are both rather slow Heroes with no mobility abilities, so it can be difficult for either of you to disengage from a fight should you run into one another. You're an easy target for Sleep Dart and Biotic Grenade, but if you can either dodge these attacks or block them with a Particle Barrier, you'll generally have the upper hand in a close-range brawl. Projected Barrier can protect under the effect of Ana's Sleep Dart; while the barrier won't wake your ally up, it will stop your enemies from ambushing your teammate and will provide you with Energy if they choose to attack. Bear in mind that if Ana's teammates get caught in Graviton Surge, she can hit them (or herself if she's in there too) with a Biotic Grenade to quickly heal a large amount of damage. Keep in mind that your barrier will cleanse the effects of Biotic Grenade, so use it wisely.
matchups.synergy: Nano-boosting a high-charged Zarya will assure that she can shred through enemies easier. The healing boost from Biotic Grenade can help sustain her in the fight with increase healing.

matchups.matchup: Baptiste's damage can provide you with Energy. Baptiste has vertical mobility, so he can disengage from a fight by leaping to higher ground. Baptiste needs up to 6 whole bursts to kill you, but it could be less since his weapon inflicts headshots. Baptiste's weapon has damage falloff, but it's also hitscan so he can fight you at mid-range. One issue with fighting Baptiste is his Immortality Field because that will shut down any Graviton Surge combo you have. You'll have no choice but to prioritize destroying the drone leaving yourself open to Baptiste (if your barriers are on cooldown). With Amplification Matrix, Baptiste has somewhat of a chance, given you stand in its line-of-sight. You can hide behind a corner and wait out the duration.
matchups.synergy: Immortality Field is useful when Zarya lacks a barrier to protect herself. Amplification Matrix will only amplify her secondary fire and Graviton Surge. Amplification Matrix will also double the healing for his secondary fire, which can sustain Zarya in a fight (given he can land his shots).

matchups.matchup: Brigette isn't much of a threat to you, just make sure to burn through her shield and try to avoid her shield bash. Beware though, your barrier will not protect you from her Whip-Flail's knockback.
matchups.synergy:
Brigette plays very similarly to Reinhart, so the tips for him should apply to her as well. 


Her ulitmate can make you even stronger, so stick close to her.

matchups.matchup: Kiriko might be hard to deal with. As long as there's a nearby ally, she can teleport to their location, escaping your damage and, potentially, line of sight. Even if your do have her cornered, she can use Protective Suzu to negate your damage and slightly push you back. Also, her weapon has no damage falloff and has a 3x multiplier when dealing critical hits.
matchups.synergy: Zarya's high damage combined with Kitsune Rush will allow her to output damage at higher energy level quicker.

matchups.matchup: Although Mercy has Guardian Angel to flee from most situations, it usually won't be far enough to send her out of your attack range. At low Energy, you may have difficulty finishing Mercy off, but at high Energy you should be able to rip through her before she can escape or heal herself. Mercy will usually stay behind her ally, so try not to engage in a 2-on-1 fight, as you will almost certainly lose.
matchups.synergy: Mercy is a good pocket for you, her damage boost can make you even stronger and her resurrection can bring you back into the fight. (Though your charge will remain lost.) Make sure to protect her with a barrier if she is using resurrection.

matchups.matchup: Moira is difficult to deal with, she has a small hitbox and high survivability. She gives very little charge and her orbs don't give you any charge at all. Her ultimate does give some decent charge, but will also damage you heavily. But if you catch her without any of her abilities, you can melt her like a candle.
matchups.synergy: Moira can keep you alive as well as combo her Coalesence with your Graviton Surge from some easy kills. This is because her ulitmate pierces barriers (Except for Zarya's.)

matchups.matchup: Zenyatta is a dire threat at range with his highly accurate Orbs of Destruction and his damage-amplifying Orb of Discord. However, his low mobility means that he won't be able to escape if you catch him off guard. You also lack mobility, though, so you'll need to take creative routes to flank him and will be incapable of chasing him if he flees. You shouldn't be flanking unless you're with your team, though, so better to leave Zenyatta for teammates who can handle him better. Your Barriers will remove Orb of Discord from yourself or an ally, but once your Barrier wears off, he can immediately reapply his Orb. While Zenyatta can't escape Graviton Surge with Transcendence, he can use it to protect all of his allies trapped in it from enemy attacks or Ultimates such as Dragonstrike or Death Blossom; try to kill Zenyatta before attempting a big play with Graviton Surge, or if you have a friendly Sombra, have her hack him prior to using your Ultimate.
matchups.synergy:
If you find yourself trapped in a Graviton Surge, a friendly Transcendence will keep you alive (most of the time) with its high healing out. Also, discorded targets are easier to melt down with your attacks. 
|}

matchups.matchup: Of all of the Support heroes, you're one of the most well-equipped to handle D.Va. Her Defense Matrix and Boosters allow her to quickly close the gap on you, but even so, your Orb of Discord and her massive frame make it a somewhat even fight. You'll need to be very jumpy and use smart Orb Volleys to remove her Mech before she kills you. If she's at a distance, she's even easier to hit with your Orb of Discord, which she has no way of blocking with her Defense Matrix. She's even more vulnerable when out of her Mech, but be cautious as her Light Gun's high firepower can still finish you off before you can eliminate her. Transcendence won't counter Self-Destruct, but in an emergency it can be used to survive or escape its blast radius.
matchups.synergy: Running a D.Va along with Zenyatta is a great idea. Her  Defense Matrix is especially useful for your survival, as your large hit box and lack of movement abilities leave you as the enemy's first target. Orb of Discord  helps D.Va do more damage, which is just as well for her burst damage engages.

matchups.matchup: Reinhardt will usually be standing firm and protecting his team and you'll be hanging back alongside your own team, making engagements rare. While you can't hit him with Orb of Discord through his shield, should he drop it for whatever reason, you can target him with it and it will remain stuck on him even if he puts his shield back up. Be careful if he closes the distance on you, though; even with Orb of Discord on him, he severely outdamages you and can clobber you in a few hammer swings.

Always be wary of Roadhog and always keep your distance from him. If you're too far away for him to snag you with his Chain Hook, he's a prime target for Orb of Discord and can be mowed down in seconds. If he sneaks up on you, though, one good Hook and you're down for the count. Stick with your team and be aware of his location whenever possible.

Winston's Jump Pack allows him to instantly approach you and begin attacking, but don't panic; your Orb of Discord and his massive frame still gives you a fighting chance to take him out. At a distance, Winston's much easier to handle. His Barrier Protector will protect him and allies from being targeted by Orb of Discord, but without it, his Tesla Cannon's pitiful range will give him no way to counter your Orbs of Destruction, outside of fleeing to safety.

Zarya's Barrier instantly nullifies your Orb of Discord, making it difficult to apply consistent damage to her. If her Barrier is down, you can still outdamage her at a distance. Just be exceptionally careful when she closes the gap on you (which is much easier with her Barrier up); with a charged up laser, you have no means of surviving her attacks. Transcendence won't help you escape Graviton Surge, but it can protect your allies from being killed during its duration.

matchups.matchup: Bastion's stationary nature makes it easy for you to attach your Orb of Discord on it and pelt it with Orbs of Destruction. While it is powerful even at a distance, your Orb of Discord will cause it to take rapid damage before it can react. You have about the same mobility as it while it's in Recon mode, but your firepower generally outpaces Bastion's. If it severely wounds you, duck behind cover while popping your head out every few seconds to make sure your Orb of Discord stays on Bastion. Your shields will recover and it'll be able to self-heal, but your Orb of Discord's presence means that your teammates can continue firing on it and dealing bonus damage. Your Orb of Discord can't be sent through barriers, so if Bastion is set up in a defensive position, you may need your team to break his protective barrier before you can apply your Orb on him.

While Cassidy's Peacekeeper can easily land shots on Zenyatta at mid to long range, his magazine is much smaller than yours, meaning you can harass Cassidy with Orbs for a prolonged period of time. His damage also suffers much more falloff than your Orbs do. Orb of Discord's visual notification can help your team spot Cassidy when he's hiding behind a wall for an ambush, letting you and your team hunt him down and kill him. Cassidy's Combat Roll is only his mobility skill, so he can't chase you down if you're too far away. However, don't get too confident when chasing Cassidy; if he ambushes you with Flashbang, you're done for. Be wary that Transcendence does nothing to protect your allies from Cassidy's Deadeye, as its one-shot burst damage will still kill anyone in its range excluding yourself. Still, if you're in Deadeye's range, activating Transcendence is acceptable as at least it will protect you from being shot down.

When it comes to facing an enemy Echo as Zenyatta, You're going to need quick reflexes and good aiming, most of the time, an enemy Echo will consider you easy prey due to your lack of  mobility and slow movement speed, which makes it easy for her to land her abilities, while this is true, you can usually defend yourself fairly well against an enemy Echo if you have good aim and she doesn't catch you by surprise, orb of discord also helps with this, if there's an enemy echo on the other team, keep watching your surroundings since an enemy Echo can easily flank you and your teammates due to her superior mobility, An enemy Echo duplicating you is rare, since there are usually better heroes to transform into, but should it happen, you should try to avoid facing her unless you're VERY confident with your aim, because even if you do win the matchup, once she loses all of her health during her ultimate she'll go back to being Echo, which can be very bad if you find yourself at low health.

Zenyatta's low mobility makes it difficult for you to flee from a Genji who's out to get you. Genji's vertical mobility and Swift Strike make it easy for him to approach you from any angle, and his Deflect gives him the upper hand when combating his master. While Orb of Discord can amplify your killing potential, Genji's Deflect will buy him time or reflect some of your orbs back at you. As long as Genji is at a close range, he can continue to harass you with Shuriken and then finish you off once you have low health with a Swift Strike. Since you can't outrun or outmaneuver Genji, your only option if caught alone is to fight back while backpedaling to regroup with your team. Even though it may be a tough fight, if you're accurate in your shots, you may be able to take the Genji out as your Orbs can hit exceptionally hard, especially when augmented with Orb of Discord. If Genji is far away from you and there's some good space separating you, you can pelt him with Orbs from a distance and there's very little he can do about it. Transcendence is a fantastic counter to Genji's Dragonblade, as it will deny Genji of the kills he needs to recharge his Swift Strike. If the enemy team has a coordinated Genji (especially if they plan to combo with Zarya's Graviton Surge), save Transcendence for that emergency.
matchups.synergy: Orb of Discord can help Genji quickly kill enemies with Swift Strike one after the other.

matchups.matchup: You excel at fighting foes at long range; unfortunately, so does Hanzo. Your slow speed and predictable movement makes it easy for him to land shots on you. Even if you duck for cover indoors, Sonic Arrow will keep him notified of your exact position. If he manages to close the gap on you, Storm Arrows will quickly kill you before you have a chance to retaliate. Dragonstrike can also be very difficult to avoid; while Transcendence can help you escape the attack and protect your teammates, there are usually other Ultimate abilities that are more dangerous that you would want to save Transcendence for.

Because your Orb of Discord requires constant line of sight, it can difficult to battle a Junkrat, who will usually be staying behind cover while launching indirect grenades your way. Should you get trapped by his Steel Trap, it's incredibly simple for him or another enemy to kill you while you're immobile, vulnerable and wounded. Concussion Mine can also launch you away from your teammates into enemy territory where you'll be surrounded and outgunned. If Junkrat is in the open, you can take the opportunity to attack at a distance. Be careful not to be hit by his grenades, though, as it only takes a few to kill you and your low mobility makes you an easy target to hit. Transcendence does little to combat RIP-Tire, outside of saving yourself.

Mei is extremely dangerous at close range, since she can quickly freeze you and you lack any means of escaping her Endothermic Blaster. Always try to be aware of her location and keep your distance. Your Orbs of Destruction will generally outdamage her icicles, but don't get cocky, as one or two well-aimed icicle shots can still make quick work of you. Transcendence won't stop your allies from being frozen by Blizzard, but it can protect them from the resulting enemy assault that usually follows Mei's Ultimate.

Zenyatta's large magazine allows you to fight back against Pharah at any range. Although Pharah's airborne status helps her avoid most projectiles, your Orb of Destruction's speed is fast enough to catch Pharah mid-air. With Orb of Discord attached to her as well, she will receive more damage and a visual identifier, making her easy for you and your teammates to shoot down. Orb of Discord can force Pharah to fall back for cover, removing her great asset of aerial supremacy. Should Pharah catch you by surprise, however, your low mobility gives you no means to escape from her. If she attacks you in an open area with little cover, you'll be forced to fight back unless your team's around to protect you. Transcendence can protect you and your teammates from Barrage, but you'll need to be able to react at a moment's notice; if you wait even a split second too long, Barrage's quick damage output can kill your or your teammates before you can protect them.

Reaper has to engage Zenyatta at very close range; should you keep your distance, he has no means with which to outdamage you. However, should Reaper close the distance on you, he's one of the most deadly opponents for you to deal with. His Hellfire Shotguns are extremely powerful at close range, and your slow movement makes it easy for him to land the few shots necessary to eliminate you. With higher health than most Damage heroes, Reaper can withstand more of your Orbs of Destruction even if he has Orb of Discord attached. Reaper can escape from a poor engagement with Wraith Form, as well as to quickly reload or to pursue should you make some distance from him, all while removing an Orb of Discord that's on him. Transcendence will negate Reaper's Death Blossom, since your healing will overwhelm his consistent damage output. Unlike Pharah's Barrage, Death Blossom's damage isn't quite so sudden, which gives you a little more reaction time before you're eliminated.

Should Sombra hack you, you'll lose the ability to fire your Orbs of Harmony and Discord. If they're on a target prior to the hack, however, they will remain there until automatically recalled (via line of sight or if their target dies). Even without your Orbs, you can handle decently in a fight with Sombra. Just keep in mind that she can escape from a poor engagement with her Translocator. If she does so, it's usually not wise to pursue; your low mobility means it'll be difficult to back out if she lures you towards the rest of her team. EMP will immediately rob you of 75% of your health while also cutting off your ability to protect your team from a big push with Transcendence; if hit by EMP, huddle behind your team and pray they can protect you, because with no mobility or health, you're going to be a prime target.

Symmetra's Photon Protector is lethal at high charge, so try to keep your distance if possible. If Symmetra shows herself out in the open, her low mobility makes it easy for you to hit her with your Orbs of Discord and Destruction to quickly strike her down. Try not to lead the charge, or else you'll be caught by her Sentry Turrets; let bulkier teammates push forward and keep them healed while they handle her turrets. While you tend to hold up the back line, keep an eye out for Symmetra's Teleporter, since if she and her team sneak up behind your team, you'll be the first target to go.

Tracer's slim model and significant mid-combat mobility makes it easy for her to avoid any and all of Zenyatta's fire when at close range. While you have the upper hand at long range, she can use Blink to either escape to cover or close the distance and flank you. Should you get her to low health, her Recall ability not only lets her recover health, but it also removes the Orb of Discord. If the enemy team has a Tracer, try to stick close to your team, as they can help you fend off a Tracer attempting to flank you.
matchups.synergy: Placing Orb of Discord on an enemy before Tracer plants a Pulse Bomb on them can ensure that the Pulse Bomb finishes them off. Also, because Orb of Discord will remain on opponents at a distance, a friendly Tracer can flank around the enemy and attack those affected by your Orb.

matchups.matchup: Your lack of mobility and slow movement make you an ideal target for Widowmaker. A fully charged bodyshot will leave you with extremely low health, making you easy to finish off unless you go for cover. It may be tempting to hit a distracted Widowmaker with Orb of Discord and try to quickly take her out, but be cautious, since if she swivels around and shoots you, you're as good as dead. It's also very easy for you to trip on a Venom Mine; your shields will eventually recover, but not until the Mine's gradual damage wears off. Your lower health will make you even easier to gun down, and Widowmaker will be able to see your exact position to land the killing blow. Be extremely cautious if you hear Widowmaker activate Infra-Sight; should you so much as peek your head out from around a corner, you may end up on the receiving end of a lethal headshot.

matchups.matchup: Like most snipers, Ana retains superiority over you at a distance due to her superior aim. If you two fight at closer range, the fight is even less in your favor, as her Biotic Grenade and Sleep Dart are excellent close range tools, while you have no means of handling enemies at close range. Her Biotic Grenade in particular not only renders your Shield regeneration useless, it will also block your affected teammates from being healed by your Orb of Harmony or Transcendence. Should you activate your Ultimate to protect your team from an enemy push, a single Biotic Grenade splash will deny your teammates from receiving your healing and will make them more vulnerable to attack. That being said, Transcendence can help protect your team from a Nano-Boosted hero, so judge accordingly. Overall, though, try to stay out of Ana's sights if possible.

Brigitte is only a threat at close range, aside from her whip shot, she has no long range weapons to damage you, meaning that as long as you keep your distance, you can quite easily pressure her with your primary fire, do be wary though, while she has low mobility just like you, her shield bash can be used to close the distance on you, and once you're on close range with Brigitte you have no means of escaping, at which point your only hope is to hit as many shots as you can before she can kill you.
Mercy's only option when fighting you is to hide behind teammates, but Orb of Discord can keep her location known to your teammates, allowing them to quickly home in on her and take her out.

A Zenyatta mirror match is one of the most fair in the game, as you can both instantly hit each other with Orb of Discord, at which point it's simply a matter of who has superior aim at landing their Orbs of Destruction. If fighting at a long distance, try to fight close to a wall so you can fall back and recharge your Shields if your health falls to dangerous levels. Since your Orb of Discord will keep you notified of the enemy Zenyatta's location, you can take this opportunity to charge up an Orb Volley e and bombard the other Zenyatta when peeking from around a corner.
